producer_report.summary: I raised MAX_CONCURRENCY_CEILING in athena-data from 8 to 16. The config error text and the `athena drain --help` text both read that constant, so both now say 16. The existing range test now checks that 16 loads and that 17 is refused with an error containing '1 to 16'. I changed the stated range to 16 in async-drain.md, parallel-jobs.md, agent-and-build-slots.md and the athena.toml comment, and added one CHANGELOG entry. `max_concurrency = 2` in athena.toml is unchanged, and no plan group size recording was added. I ran the targeted athena-data config tests, the athena-cli help tests and the policy scan, and all passed. I did not run the full suite, clippy or fmt.

both help tests and the drain.rs help tests pass

I did not run the full cargo test suite, clippy or fmt; Athena runs them.
mistakes: My first CHANGELOG edit failed because '### Added' occurs 20 times. I retried with the '## [Unreleased]' heading as context.
learnings: MAX_CONCURRENCY_CEILING also bounds the pipeline max_in_flight, so that limit rises to 16 too. The drain help and the config error both read the constant, so neither needed its own edit.
